audit.whatIsWrong: content.win[] says Jayce owns Levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items, while the whys on the very same page say 'Level 2 is Zaahen's', 'Level 3 stays his', 'First item is Zaahen's' and '2+ items stays his'. The full layer's phases[].side repeats the same inverted chart.
audit.why: The prose, the packet levelChart (Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen/Skill/Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen) and the 47.1% win rate over 1552 games all agree with each other and disagree with the chart. Zaahen gets Aureate Rush online at 2-3 and out-brawls a cannon-form Jayce; nothing in either kit supports Jayce owning those stages.
audit.corrected: Chart should read Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen/Skill/Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen. NOT applied — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has only three entries where every other matchup has four, and none of the three names an ability.
audit.why: The three that exist point at the right moments (his 2-3 gap-close, the 4-5 gate-spacing reset, his first item), but they describe them as 'his gap-close' and 'E-into-R' rather than Aureate Rush (10s at rank 1, 8s maxed) and Grim Deliverance (110s at rank 1). Level 6 has no spike entry at all, which is the stage his ultimate arrives.
audit.corrected: Real names put into the three existing entries; the missing fourth entry is left for the user since entry counts are fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Zaahen ability is named anywhere in either layer — the full layer literally calls his ultimate 'Ultimate' and tracks it as the matchup-defining cooldown. Three decisive interactions are entirely absent.
audit.why: Riot kit: The Darkin Glaive is an auto-attack reset that heals him and can be recast for a knockup, so the tell is his auto wind-up and Grievous Wounds is the counter. Aureate Rush is his only gap-close (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) and deals percent max health, so stacking raw HP is the wrong answer. Dreaded Return (14s) pulls you toward him, which is what actually undoes a Thundering Blow knockback. Grim Deliverance is 110s at rank 1 and heals off the damage. On top of that, Cultivation of War lets him revive at full Determination — a won trade is not always a won fight.
audit.corrected: Name the abilities and state the reset, the pull, the percent-health dash and the revive.
